dialogues.speaker: Floral Throne
dialogues.text: "...Seek the blossom of eternity, and reclaim memories long-lost..."

dialogues.speaker: Floral Throne
dialogues.text: (You notice a letter missing from each inscription written on the three thrones...)

dialogues.speaker: Floral Throne
dialogues.text: (...Perhaps you can use the clues in the inscriptions to rediscover what was lost?)
